title: Upgrade Kiichain to v8.0.2
summary:
Coordinated upgrade of Kiichain mainnet to v8.0.2.

The upgrade is scheduled for Friday 2026-10-30 around 17:00:00 UTC (block height 11,495,118).

This release is being created in a disclosed manner due to security fixes from Cosmos EVM private patches and binaries are available for download on GitHub.

Validators should download the v8.0.2 binary, verify the checksum, and stage it in cosmovisor under the upgrade plan name v8.0.0 before the upgrade height.

The plan name stays v8.0.0 because it matches the v8.0.0 upgrade handler included in v8.0.2, which adds the Cosmos SDK x/circuit store and runs module migrations.

Changelog, binaries and release details:
 https://github.com/KiiChain/kiichain/releases/tag/v8.0.2
